    1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
    2: """Inspect input .npz files for PENROSE-ACCESS-59 - v2."""
    3: import numpy as np
    4: import os
    5: 
    6: outlines = []
    7: 
    8: def inspect(path, label):
    9:     outlines.append(f"\n=== {label}: {path} ===")
   10:     if not os.path.exists(path):
   11:         outlines.append(f"  FILE NOT FOUND")
   12:         return None
   13:     outlines.append(f"  FILE EXISTS, size={os.path.getsize(path)} bytes")
   14:     f = np.load(path, allow_pickle=True)
   15:     outlines.append(f"  Arrays: {f.files}")
   16:     for k in sorted(f.files):
   17:         v = f[k]
   18:         outlines.append(f"  {k}: shape={v.shape}, dtype={v.dtype}")
   19:         if v.ndim == 0:
   20:             outlines.append(f"    scalar value: {v.item()}")
   21:         elif v.size <= 30:
   22:             outlines.append(f"    values: {v}")
   23:         else:
   24:             outlines.append(f"    first 10: {v.flat[:10]}")
   25:             outlines.append(f"    last 5:  {v.flat[-5:]}")
   26:     return f
